title: Pure Windwitch
summary: Pure Windwitch build with WIND Synchros, Xyz, and Links plus generic staples. Windwitch is a WIND Spellcaster Synchro engine that inflicts effect damage while climbing into an indestructible Crystal Wing Synchro Dragon and Windwitch - Diamond Bell.

summary.title: Starters
points: Windwitch - Ice Bell Special Summons itself from the hand when you control no monsters, Special Summons a Windwitch from the Deck, and inflicts 500 burn damage; it locks you to WIND Special Summons for the turn and Level 5 or higher WIND monsters from the Extra Deck.
Windwitch - Glass Bell is a Level 4 Tuner that searches any Windwitch monster (except itself) when Normal or Special Summoned, locking you to WIND Special Summons for the rest of the turn.
Windwitch Chimes targets a Windwitch monster you control to Special Summon one with a different name from the Deck, also locking you to WIND Special Summons for the turn.

summary.title: Opening: Windwitch - Ice Bell (1-Card Crystal Wing)
steps: Special Summon Windwitch - Ice Bell onto an empty field, summon Windwitch - Glass Bell from the Deck, inflict 500 damage with Ice Bell, and search Windwitch - Snow Bell with Glass Bell.
Since you control two WIND monsters and no non-WIND monsters, Special Summon Level 1 Tuner Windwitch - Snow Bell from the hand.
Synchro Summon Level 7 Windwitch - Winter Bell using Level 3 Ice Bell and Level 4 Tuner Glass Bell, then use Winter Bell to inflict 800 burn damage by targeting Glass Bell in the GY.

Synchro Summon Level 8 Crystal Wing Synchro Dragon (or Windwitch - Diamond Bell) using Level 7 Winter Bell and Level 1 Tuner Snow Bell, making the Synchro Monster indestructible by your opponent's card effects.

summary.title: Burn & Destruction Synergy
summary.text: Windwitch - Diamond Bell destroys a card on the field on Synchro Summon, and once per turn when the opponent takes battle or effect damage it destroys another card on the field (twice per turn if Synchro Summoned using only Windwitch materials). Ice Bell, Winter Bell, and Windwitch - Blizzard Bell (which Tributes itself from the hand or field as a Quick Effect during the opponent's Main Phase to inflict 500 damage) all trigger Diamond Bell's pop on demand.

summary.title: Bosses & WIND Toolbox
points: Crystal Wing Synchro Dragon negates and destroys a monster effect activation once per turn, gains that monster's original ATK, and cannot be destroyed by opponent's card effects when made with Windwitch - Snow Bell.
Mist Wurm and Stellar Wind Wolfrayet provide Level 9 WIND Synchro options alongside Cloudcastle, while Maple Maiden and Orient Dragon cover Levels 7 and 6.

When you do not use Ice Bell's Level 5+ Extra Deck lock, Windwitch - Freeze Bell and Level 3/4 Windwitches access Rank 4 Lightning Chidori, Rank 3 Totem Bird, Link-2 Greatfly, and Link-3 Hraesvelgr, the Desperate Doom Eagle.
Icy Breeze Refrain revives a Windwitch from the GY in Defense Position or prevents the opponent from responding to your Windwitch monster effect activations for the turn.

summary.title: Left out
summary.text: Windwitch - Crystal Bell is omitted because the pure build runs no Fusion Spells.
